ideas.title: Investigating the Federal Reserve Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ongoing investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, including the potential implications for the US economy and the independence of the Federal Reserve.
questions: What are the potential implications of the investigation for the US economy?
How might the investigation affect the independence of the Federal Reserve?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant information about the management of the US economy and the potential for political interference in the Federal Reserve. By following the money and investigating the potential implications of the investigation, we may be able to uncover new information and shed light on the inner workings of the Federal Reserve.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the fraud scandal in Minnesota, including the potential scope and nature of the fraud, and the steps being taken to prevent similar incidents in the future.
questions: What is the scope and nature of the fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent similar incidents in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant information about the management of child care assistance funds in Minnesota, and potentially other states. By analyzing data and investigating the potential implications of the scandal, we may be able to uncover new information and shed light on the inner workings of the system.
